Neha Joshi  
Email: neha.joshi@medtechinnovations.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/neha-joshi | GitHub: github.com/neha-joshi  
Location: Berlin, Germany | Phone: +49 123 456 7890  

A seasoned machine learning engineer with a focus on healthtech innovation, blending technical rigor with cross-functional collaboration to deliver scalable solutions for complex medical challenges. Over seven years of experience designing and deploying production-grade models, optimizing workflows for clinical teams, and driving data-driven decisions in high-stakes environments. Known for translating domain-specific pain points into robust, interpretable systems that enhance patient outcomes and operational efficiency.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **GCP**: Spearheaded end-to-end deployment of predictive analytics pipelines on Google Cloud, reducing model latency by 40% through optimized BigQuery integration and managed AI services. Owned infrastructure upgrades for 5+ models, achieving 95%+ uptime and 30% cost reduction via auto-scaling and resource tagging.  
- **AWS**: Architect for a federated learning framework enabling secure model training across 12+ hospitals, reducing data transfer overhead by 65% while maintaining compliance with GDPR and HIPAA. Mentored 6 engineers on best practices for EC2 spot instances and S3 data governance.  
- **Docker**: Designed containerization strategy for 15+ ML models, streamlining deployment across 4 environments and cutting manual configuration time by 50%. Trained 10+ developers on CI/CD pipelines, resulting in 2x faster release cycles.  
- **MLOps (MLflow/W&B)**: Built centralized tracking system for 80+ models, improving collaboration between data scientists and engineering teams by 70%. Automated model retraining workflows, reducing maintenance overhead by 40% and ensuring compliance with regulatory audits.  
- **NLP**: Developed natural language processing pipelines for clinical text summarization, achieving 88% F1 score on discharge summaries and reducing manual annotation time by 60% for 500+ physicians. Integrated BERT-based models into EHR systems to flag critical patient trends.  
- **Model deployment**: Transitioned 12+ models from prototyping to production using Flask-Gunicorn and Kubernetes, achieving 99.9% availability. Implemented A/B testing frameworks for 3 high-impact models, driving 15% improvement in diagnostic accuracy.  
- **Kubernetes**: Orchestrated scalable deployments for distributed ML workloads, reducing downtime by 80% during peak usage. Automated rollback processes for 10+ critical models, ensuring zero-downtime updates.  

**Professional Experience**  
**Senior ML Engineer**  
*MedTech Innovations* | Berlin, Germany | 2020–Present  
Led a team of 6 engineers in developing AI-driven diagnostic tools for chronic disease management, integrating 10+ medical datasets to improve prediction accuracy by 22% for diabetes risk scoring. Designed and deployed a real-time anomaly detection system for ICU monitoring, reducing false positives by 35% through ensemble model tuning. Collaborated with clinical teams to refine model interpretability, ensuring FDA-compliant documentation for 3 regulated products.  

**Machine Learning Engineer**  
*VitalSigns Health* | San Francisco, USA | 2017–2020  
Architected NLP solutions for medical record normalization, processing 20M+ clinical notes and improving data quality by 55% for downstream analytics. Optimized model inference pipelines for 500+ hospitals, reducing average response time from 12s to 2.5s. Pioneered a hybrid cloud architecture combining GCP and AWS for data storage, cutting costs by 25% while maintaining 99.99% SLA.  

**Data Scientist Intern**  
*HealthAI Labs* | Seattle, USA | 2016  
Built predictive models for sepsis detection using ICU time-series data, achieving 82% AUC in validation. Automated feature engineering workflows using Python and SQL, reducing preprocessing time by 40% for 10+ datasets.  

**Education**  
*Master of Science in Data Science* | University of Washington | 2018  
Thesis: *Leveraging Federated Learning for Secure Collaborative Model Training in Healthcare*  

**Projects**  
- **Clinical Predictive Analytics Platform**: Developed a scalable system for forecasting readmission risks using ensemble methods, deployed on GCP with 92% accuracy and 95% availability.  
- **EHR Integration Framework**: Designed modular APIs to synchronize 15+ EHR systems, reducing data latency by 50% and enabling real-time insights for 200+ providers.
